meta.name: env-and-assets-bootstrap
meta.description: Rigor Setup skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to prepare a conservative conda-first environment, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache location hints, and setup notes before any run on a README-documented repository. Do not use for repo scanning, full orchestration, paper interpretation, final run reporting, or generic environment setup that is not tied to a specific reproduction target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为深度学习仓库准备 conda 环境和数据路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地复现深度学习项目并快速搭建运行环境。
copy.tagline_en: Prepare conda environment and data paths for deep learning repos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reproduce deep learning projects locally with quick environment setup.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你准备深度学习项目的运行环境：创建 conda 环境、规划模型和数据集路径、提示缓存位置，并给出安装前的注意事项。
howto.when: 当你要求复现一个 GitHub 上的深度学习项目，且需要先搭建环境、准备模型文件或数据集时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个仓库准备 conda 环境和模型路径。
say.note: Claude 会分析 README 并给出环境搭建步骤。

say.text: 这个项目需要下载哪些数据集？路径怎么设？
say.note: Claude 会列出数据集来源和存放建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps prepare the environment for deep learning repo reproduction: create conda environment, plan checkpoint and dataset paths, hint cache locations, and provide setup notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to reproduce a deep learning project from a GitHub repo and need environment setup, model files, or dataset preparation first.

say_en.text: Prepare the conda environment and asset paths for this repo.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze README and give setup steps.

say_en.text: Which datasets are needed and where should they be placed?
say_en.note: Claude will list dataset sources and path suggestions.
